Item 4. Purpose of Transaction
On March 2, 2026, the Reporting Person entered into a support agreement with the Issuer and Zenith Pharma Inc. in connection with the proposed merger of the Issuer. The Reporting Person agreed to vote its shares in favor of the merger and related strategic transaction.
Item 5. Interest in Securities of the Issuer
The Reporting Person's beneficial ownership decreased from 9.8% to 4.1% after the sale of 3,000,000 shares in private transactions.
